description: Apple has secured regulatory approval to launch Apple Intelligence on iPhones in China, marking a major step towards bringing its AI features to one of its largest smartphone markets. The service will integrate AI models from Alibaba and Baidu to comply with local regulations, although Apple has not confirmed a rollout date. The approval comes after a lengthy wait, as China's rules require generative AI services to obtain clearance before public release. Apple recently reported higher iPhone shipments in China during the second quarter.
title: Apple Intelligence Cleared for Use on iPhone in China, Will Rely on Chinese AI Models: Report

description: The US Department of the Treasury and the UK’s HM Treasury have unveiled joint recommendations to strengthen cooperation on tokenised finance and stablecoins. Developed through the Transatlantic Task Force for the Markets of the Future, the proposals call for coordinated regulatory approaches, industry-led testing of cross-border tokenised assets, and aligned stablecoin standards. The initiative reflects growing efforts by both countries to shape interoperable digital asset markets while supporting financial stability.
title: US, UK Treasuries Seek Common Framework for Tokenisation and Stablecoins

description: Capcom is said to have begun pre-production on a remake of Resident Evil 1. According to a tipster, the remake project entered early production phase "nearly a year ago". Capcom has not yet confirmed a remake of Resident Evil 1 but the company confirmed a remake of Resident Evil – Code: Veronica last month.
title: Resident Evil 1 Remake Said to Have Entered Pre-Production Phase Last Year

description: The Union Cabinet has approved the Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme, the Ministry of Information Technology and Electronics (MeitY) announced on Wednesday. The new scheme has a budgetary outlay of Rs. 62,500 crore. It aims to “further scale” phone production in India, “deepen value addition”, and “strengthen” the supply chains involved in handset manufacturing. The ministry also says that its launch will improve global competitiveness. Under the Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme, the government will provide incentives to phone manufacturers based on eligible sales in India at differentiated rates, ranging from 2.25 percent to 5 percent.
title: Cabinet Approves Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme With Rs. 62,500 Crore Budget to Scale Domestic Production

description: Google is introducing a new programme that will let eligible third-party Android app stores in the US surface apps from the Play Store beginning July 22. Participating marketplaces must meet Google's security, privacy and marketplace requirements and pay an annual review fee of $5,000 (roughly Rs. 4,81,400). Although apps can be discovered through third-party stores, downloads will continue to be processed through Google Play. The move follows Google's compliance with a US court order.
title: Google Announces Play Catalog Access Program for Third-Party App Stores on Android Devices

description: Microsoft is reportedly planning to bring various new features to the Phone Link app on Windows 11 devices. Microsoft is said to be working on an update that will display “more recent activities” from the user’s connected handset within the Start menu panel. Users will reportedly be able to scroll through the list from the Start menu panel, eliminating the need for them to open the Phone Link app. The functionality might let Windows 11 users hover the pointer over specific recent activities to view more information about them, including messages and attached images.
title: Microsoft to Revamp Phone Link App With Better Smartphone Integration on Windows 11: Report

description: The UK’s HM Revenue and Customs will introduce a “no gain, no loss” tax treatment for certain crypto lending and liquidity pool transactions from April 6, 2027. The measure defers capital gains tax until a participant makes an economic disposal of their digital assets. Expected to affect around 700,000 taxpayers and trustees, the policy aims to better align crypto taxation with the economic nature of decentralised finance activities.
title: UK Tax Authority Announces ‘No Gain, No Loss’ Treatment for Select Crypto Transactions

description: Xiaomi appears to have quietly started distributing stable Android 17-based software to some of its devices. The rollout is said to be limited to the vanilla Xiaomi 17 and the Xiaomi 17 Ultra. Xiaomi 15T Pro is also reportedly receiving the Android 17-based HyperOS 3 update through Xiaomi's Mi Pilot testing channel, which is available for a limited number of participants.
title: Xiaomi 17 Series Reportedly Receives Stable Android 17-Based HyperOS 3 Update

description: OnePlus N6x will be launched in India soon, the tech firm revealed on Wednesday. A dedicated microsite for the upcoming smartphone has been made live on Amazon, confirming its availability via the e-commerce platform in the country. The soon-to-be-launched OnePlus N6x will arrive as the second model in the tech firm’s new entry-level N series. A tipster claims that the handset will arrive with familiar specifications and features. This comes shortly after the OnePlus N6 was launched in India with an 8,000mAh battery and a MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Apex chipset.
title: OnePlus N6x India Launch Teased Shortly After OnePlus N6 Arrives

description: Huawei FreeClip 2 S has been launched globally alongside the Huawei Pura 90s series and MatePad Air 2026. The open-ear wireless earbuds feature dual 10.8mm dual-diaphragm drivers, spatial audio with dynamic head tracking and AI-backed audio processing. They support Bluetooth 6.0, dual-device connectivity and offer up to nine hours of playback on a single charge or up to 38 hours with the charging case. The earbuds also support wireless charging, IP57 dust and water resistance and automatic left and right channel recognition.
title: Huawei FreeClip 2 S Launched Globally With Open-Ear Design and Up to 38-Hour Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Canva Code 2.0 is available to users starting today. The new AI-powered app and website creation tool is available for all Free, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education users. Users can access it directly within existing design projects, including presentations, whiteboards, and documents. HTML import tool allow users to bring work created using other AI assistants into Canva as an editable design.
title: Canva Code 2.0 With Vibe Coding Support for Website Building Now Available to All Users

description: Spotify on Tuesday announced a new conversational AI experience that offers the ability to interact using natural language. According to the Swedish music streaming platform, users will have access to a ChatGPT-like interface, using which they can ask Spotify to play music, refine playlists, learn more about songs and artists, revisit their listening history, and explore podcasts and audiobooks through a ChatGPT-like interface. The feature is currently rolling out in beta for eligible Spotify Premium subscribers.
title: Spotify Rolls Out Conversational ChatGPT-Like Conversational AI Assistant for Music Discovery

description: GoBoult Tenet Pro has been launched in India as the successor to the GoBoult Tenet introduced earlier this year. The true wireless earbuds feature 13mm dynamic drivers, 32dB active noise cancellation and quad microphone environmental noise cancellation. They support Bluetooth 5.4, dual device connectivity, AI Voice Assistant, 45ms gaming mode and the GoBoult AmpApp. The earbuds are claimed to deliver up to 75 hours of playback with the charging case and support fast charging over a USB Type-C port.
title: GoBoult Tenet Pro Launched in India With Up to 32dB ANC, Up to 75 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Realme Narzo 100x 5G was launched in India in two colour options with an 8,000mAh battery. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G chipset, paired with up to 6GB of RAM and up to 256GB of storage. It runs on Realme UI 7.0 based on Android 16 and has a 6.8-inch HD+ LCD panel with a 144Hz refresh rate. It has a 50-megapixel rear camera unit and 45W charging support.
title: Realme Narzo 100x 5G Launched in India With 8,000mAh Battery, MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Digital assets advanced after improving macroeconomic conditions lifted investor confidence. Analysts, however, said geopolitical tensions, uneven institutional participation, and technical resistance could keep volatility elevated despite the latest gains.
title: Bitcoin Climbs Above $65,000 as Softer US Inflation Lifts Crypto Market

description: Samsung has introduced its new Flex Titanium display technology, which will be found on upcoming Samsung foldables. Samsung claims that the Flex Titanium technology helps in reducing the visible crease in the middle of the screen, which is found on most foldables. On top of this, the company says that it also improves the screen durability and offers a more immersive viewing experience, while keeping the panel thin. The tech giant said that more details will be revealed during the event, which is expected to see the launch of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, and Galaxy Z Flip 8.
title: Samsung Unveils Flex Titanium Display Technology to Minimise Visible Crease on Upcoming Galaxy Foldables

description: Following the introduction of the Redmi Note 17 series in China yesterday, the rumour mill now suggests a new Poco handset could be on the horizon for India and the international markets. According to a tipster, one of the models in the Note 17 lineup could be rebranded as an upcoming Poco smartphone. However, models meant for China, India, and the global markets are tipped to have slightly different specifications, including varied battery capacities.
title: Poco M8 Power Said to Arrive in India With Similar Specs as Redmi Note 17; Global Note 17 Variants May Have Smaller Batteries
Three AI Models, One Phone: The Latest from OPPO’s ColorOS 16 on the Reno16 Series

description: Motorola Edge 70 Max has been launched in India as the latest addition to the company's Edge 70 lineup. The handset is set to go on sale in India via Flipkart in Pantone Aqua Gray, Pantone Dark Shadow, and Pantone Ice Melt colour options. Qualcomm’s recently released 3nm octa core Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset powers the Motorola Edge 70 Max. For optics, the Motorola Edge 70 Max carries a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel (f/1.8) primary shooter with a Sony LYT-710 sensor and optical image stabilisation.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Max Launched in India With 7,100mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Chrome's latest AI features are rolling out to desktop users in the UK. It is confirmed to expand to iOS next month. With Gemini in Chrome, users in the UK can now chat with a personalised browsing assistant to summarise lengthy content or compare information across multiple tabs. It offers AI assistance in the browser to easily get key takeaways, clarify concepts, find answers and more. It was initially launched in the US.
title: Google Expands Gemini in Chrome to the UK, iOS Support Coming Soon

description: OpenAI has long been rumoured to foray into the consumer hardware business with an AI-powered device. While the rumour mill previously claimed that the ChatGPT maker could introduce an AI headset as its first-ever hardware device, a recent leak suggests otherwise. According to a report, the company is developing a portable, screen-free smart speaker that could serve as an AI-powered home companion. The purported AI device is expected to run on a rechargeable battery, allowing it to be carried between rooms.
title: OpenAI’s First AI Device Could Be a Smart Speaker with Built-In Camera, GPT-Live Capabilities: Report

description: A full remake of the acclaimed original, Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced comes with undeniable technical upgrades, but the real task in front of it is to find the pirate soul of a game that many still consider among the best in the series.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Review: Ubisoft's Remake Unearths Buried Pirate Gold

description: Insta360 X6 has surfaced in a new specifications leak that reveals several upgrades ahead of its official launch. The 360-degree action camera is tipped to feature dual 1/1.1-inch 42-megapixel sensors, support 8K recording at up to 50fps and capture 120-megapixel 360-degree photos. The report also points to a brighter OLED display, a larger 2,600mAh battery, FlowState stabilisation and 11K time-lapse recording. Earlier leaks have also hinted at a redesigned body and a higher launch price.
title: Insta360 X6 Leak Hints at Upgraded Display, 120-Megapixel Photo Support and 8K 360-Degree Video

description: Apple will equip the next-generation iPad Mini with an 8.4-inch “hybrid” OLED display, with the low-temperature polycrystalline silicon (LTPS) technology, a tipster claims. The compact tablet will reportedly offer a fixed refresh rate of 60Hz refresh rate, which is identical to its predecessor, which was launched in October 2024 with an 8.3-inch Liquid Retina IPS LCD screen and the A17 Pro chipset. This comes despite the rumours that the new iPad Mini model will be the first in the lineup to ship with an OLED display.
title: Apple’s Next-Generation iPad Mini Might Feature a 60Hz Panel Despite Long-Awaited OLED Upgrade

description: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag 3 is tipped to launch later this year alongside the Galaxy S26 FE smartphone. The new Galaxy tracking device is expected to provide Samsung with an opportunity to narrow the gap with Apple's AirTag and Google's Find Hub-based trackers. Samsung released the Galaxy SmartTag 2 back in October 2023. It is offered in Black and White colour options and priced at Rs. 2,799 in India.
title: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag 3 Could Launch Later This Year to Take on Apple's AirTag

description: Google Pixel Watch 5 has appeared in official-looking leaked renders ahead of its expected August 12 launch. The images reveal four colour options, updated band pairings and a new watch face with a Gemini shortcut. The smartwatch is expected to arrive in 41mm and 45mm sizes with Wi-Fi and LTE variants. The report also suggests a $50 price increase, while earlier leaks point to Wear OS 7, larger batteries, a new Tensor processor and availability from August 20.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Official-Looking Renders Reveal Watch Face and New Colour Options

description: With just a week to go for Samsung's next Galaxy Unpacked event, fresh leaks continue to reveal new details about the upcoming Galaxy devices. Official-looking promotional images of the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, Galaxy Z Flip 8, Galaxy Watch 9, and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 have now surfaced, which offer a closer look at the upcoming foldables and smartwatches. Separately, the rumour mill suggests Samsung may scale back one of its most popular pre-order benefits this year due to rising memory costs.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Flip 8 Official-Looking Images Reportedly Leak; Storage Upgrade Offer May Change

description: The Redmi K100 series has been rumoured to launch earlier than previously anticipated. While the company has yet to confirm the handsets, a tipster has shed light on the key specifications of what appears to be a high-end Redmi K100 series model. The purported handset could feature a 185Hz display. Under the hood, it is expected to be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. The Redmi K100 series device may pack a battery nearing the 9,000mAh mark.
title: Redmi K100 Series Prototype Tipped to Feature 185Hz Display, 9,000mAh Battery, 200-Megapixel Camera
